# Bundled fonts

The app bundles these Google Fonts releases under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The license for each font is included in this directory.

| App resource | Font | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `res/font/zhi_mang_xing.ttf` | Zhi Mang Xing | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/zhimangxing | [ZhiMangXing-OFL.txt](ZhiMangXing-OFL.txt) |
| `res/font/dancing_script.ttf` | Dancing Script | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dancingscript | [DancingScript-OFL.txt](DancingScript-OFL.txt) |
| `res/font/caveat.ttf` | Caveat | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/caveat | [Caveat-OFL.txt](Caveat-OFL.txt) |
